# RAG with Claude + Oracle AI Database Vector Search

This example shows how to build a simple Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using:

- Claude (Anthropic) for generation
- Oracle AI Database Vector Search for retrieval

## Prerequisites
- Oracle AI Database (Free or Autonomous)
- Anthropic API key
- Python 3.10+

## What you will learn
- Store embeddings in Oracle AI Database
- Run vector similarity search
- Use retrieved context to ground Claude’s answers
